title: The Four Stages of Monday: If one more meeting that should've been a meme, we need to talk about stage of Monday
caption:
If one more meeting that should've been a meme, we need to talk about stage of Monday

You've seen every one of these. Denial is free:
1️⃣ The Denial Snooze — Alarm says 7. You negotiate like a lawyer until 7:34. The bed wins every single round.
2️⃣ The Coffee Bargaining — Cup one: hope. Cup two: negotiation. Cup three: you're emailing legal about a meeting from March.
3️⃣ The Fake Productivity — Color-coding a to-do list is not work, but it looks incredible on camera. Inbox zero is a personality now.
4️⃣ The Sunday Flashback — 4pm hits and you remember Sunday existed. Monday, undefeated. Same time next week, champ.

Tag the friend who is #1 (they won't admit it).
